description.description: A grainy, sepia-toned photograph showing a large group of men in simple loincloths or wraps appearing to carry massive prehistoric-style stone blocks on their shoulders. The image is a composite or staged artistic representation likely meant to illustrate ancient construction methods, as the scale of the blocks relative to the men is physically impossible for human strength alone. Several men stand in the foreground watching or crouching on a rocky, uneven ground.
